resources.string: Privacy-first link sharing, without the tracking junk.
Share any link to LinkCleaner from your apps. We instantly strip tracking parameters, then open a new share sheet with a clean URL.
Select any text containing a link, hit Share, and send it to LinkCleaner. We detect and clean URLs inside longer messages too.
Open the app from your launcher to read tips, manage settings, or test cleaning before sending links to others.
LinkCleaner is now ready.\n\nUse the Share button in apps like Spotify, Instagram, or Amazon and pick LinkCleaner to send privacy-friendly links.
Paste a URL and remove tracking junk in one tap.
A tiny link cleaner for sharing without tracking clutter.
Tip: try pasting a YouTube or news link with a bunch of “utm_…” params.
